items.title: Pete Jolly interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: There are some names like that. Joe Garigola. It’s similar. It’s Seregioli.

ctx.x: And then you’ve got to deal with the “ja” is it — © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
Yeah. There are some names like that. Joe Garigola. It’s similar. It’s Seregioli. My father was Italian of course.
Was he a first generation or had you been in that area for a long time?
